rule: Candidate IDs and text are immutable inputs. Judges must not infer provenance or see other judges' responses.

candidates.name: push_echo
candidates.update: set push_dir from impulse direction; set echo=1; decay echo toward 0 each tick
candidates.action: bias movement toward push_dir proportional to echo
candidates.interesting_failure: repeated shoves can make the actor appear compulsively attracted to an aggressor

candidates.name: edge_grudge
candidates.trigger: support contacts drop abruptly from nonzero to zero
candidates.update: store recent travel direction as danger_dir; increase grudge; decay grudge only while supported
candidates.action: while grudge is high, bias movement opposite danger_dir and hesitate before matching it
candidates.interesting_failure: narrow platforms can produce oscillatory indecision

candidates.name: jam_ritual
candidates.trigger: commanded movement remains high while displacement stays below threshold
candidates.update: accumulate jam; on threshold advance phase; decay jam after free movement
candidates.action: phase 0 reverses briefly, phase 1 turns sharply, phase 2 performs one jump then resets
candidates.interesting_failure: soft obstacles can provoke unnecessary ritualized escape cycles

candidates.name: borrowed_courage
candidates.trigger: nearby actor accelerates successfully toward open space
candidates.update: copy neighbour acceleration direction locally and raise courage; decay courage without successful self-motion
candidates.action: bias movement along borrow_dir while courage remains above threshold
candidates.interesting_failure: groups can stampede together into a newly appearing hazard

candidates.name: impact_freeze
candidates.trigger: large collision impulse while current speed exceeds threshold
candidates.update: set freeze proportional to impulse; decay only while contact forces remain low
candidates.action: suppress movement and turning while freeze is high, then recover gradually
candidates.interesting_failure: persistent jostling can lock an actor into learned-helplessness-looking immobility

candidates.name: wall_scent
candidates.trigger: sustained lateral contact with a surface
candidates.update: remember contact side and increase trace; decay trace away from surfaces
candidates.action: after losing contact, curve gently toward the remembered side until trace fades
candidates.interesting_failure: the actor may orbit convex obstacles after only brushing them once

candidates.name: counterfeit_prediction
candidates.trigger: velocity direction changes sharply without a matching commanded turn
candidates.update: extrapolate expected_dir from recent velocity; lower confidence on mismatch; recover confidence during stable motion
candidates.action: when confidence is low, reduce speed and alternate small left/right probes
candidates.interesting_failure: rough terrain can cause endless cautious probing despite no obstacle

candidates.name: refractory_pounce
candidates.trigger: target-like local motion crosses the forward sensor arc
candidates.update: accumulate charge while motion remains in arc; after jump set refractory=1 and decay it over time
candidates.action: jump forward when charge crosses threshold and refractory is zero
candidates.interesting_failure: periodic environmental motion can entrain the actor into repeated mistimed pounces
